_comment: Workflow steps that invoke a repo path which does not exist, per scripts/ci/check-workflow-targets.mjs. Every entry needs a REASON naming why the step is still here. These are not safe — each one fails the moment its workflow runs. This list may shrink, never grow.

cerv2-staging-deploy.yml -> client/src/p.reason: BROKEN, KEPT VISIBLE. cerv2-staging-deploy.yml's "Phase 9 file integrity check" hard-fails (exit 1) when any of its 12 listed files is missing. All 12 are missing: the .jsx components went in 7a144fd1e ("delete all non-Claude-Design UI under client/src/") and CERV2EditorAI.jsx in 3feb6a5af (pages/ reorganisation); no file matching *cerv2* remains anywhere under client/src. The workflow fires on workflow_dispatch AND on any rc-* tag push, so the release-candidate pipeline currently stops at its first gate — it has simply not been run since the deletions. Not resolved here because the choice is a product one: either the Phase 9 surface was genuinely retired and the step should go, or it was ported and the step should name the files that replaced it. Guessing either way would either delete a deploy gate or invent a manifest. Recorded so it is visible before someone cuts an RC.

cerv2-staging-deploy.yml -> scripts/cerv.reason: BROKEN, KEPT DELIBERATELY. The CERV2 API smoke test that gates the staging deploy. The script was removed by b79f020e1 (dead-code purge); the workflow is workflow_dispatch-only, so the step has never been observed to fail. Left in place rather than deleted because a deploy whose verification step vanished would deploy silently — this one at least stops. Restore the script or replace the step with a verification that exists.

ci-staging-integration.yml -> requiremen.reason: BROKEN, KEPT DELIBERATELY. The Part 11 staging smoke installs from a root requirements-staging.txt that no longer exists. workflow_dispatch-only, so never observed. The smoke test it installs for (scripts/e2e_staging_smoke.py) DOES still exist, so the step is worth repairing rather than deleting.

ci-staging-integration.yml -> scripts/ge.reason: BROKEN, KEPT DELIBERATELY. Generates the ALCOA+ compliance report from the evidence directory; removed by b79f020e1. Runs `if: always()`, so it fails the run even when the smoke test passed. Kept visible because a Part 11 evidence run that quietly stops producing its report is the worse failure of the two.

test-assembly.yml -> scripts/e2e_smoke_a.reason: BROKEN, KEPT DELIBERATELY. Optional assembly e2e, gated on the TEST_DATABASE_URL secret; the script was removed by b79f020e1. The sibling step in the same job (scripts/check_assembly_docs.mjs) still exists and still runs, so the job is live and only this step is dead.
